name: Dinosaur Bloodline
body:
Sorcerers from tribal societies often develop powers from the local fauna, in this case the large and intimidating dinosaurs surrounding the region.

Class Skill: Survival.

Bonus Spells: thunderstomp (3rd), summon monster II (5th), swarm of fangs (7th), charm monster (9th), hold monster (11th), bull’s strength, mass (13th), summon monster VII (15th), charm monster, mass (17th), clashing rocks (19th).

Bonus Feats: Improved Initiative, Endurance, Diehard, Improved Critical (Bite), Critical Focus, Skill Focus (Survival), Spell Focus (Transmutation).

Bloodline Arcana: Due to a lengthy tail now protruding from their body, the sorcerer receives a +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks (and a further +2 on balance-related checks).

Bloodline Powers:

Saurian Bulk (Ex): At 1st level, the sorcerer always calculates damage for their natural attacks as if they are their natural size (for a medium creature, they always calculate as if they are medium size, even if their size would change from a spell or ability). This only functions out to two size categories, after which it instead increases the damage as if they were one size category larger; thus if they shrink to diminutive size and receive a bite attack, they deal damage as per a tiny creature instead.

At 7th level the sorcerer calculates as if they are one size category larger than their natural size. At 11th level this functions for all sizes smaller than them, not just two sizes down.

Long Legs (Ex): At 3rd level, the sorcerer increases their land speed by 10 feet.

Pebbly Skin (Ex): At 9th level, the sorcerer receives a natural armor bonus to AC equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum of 0).

Grabbing Maw (Ex): At 15th level, the sorcerer treats their base attack bonus as equal to their level when they transform into another creature or would attack with a natural attack that is not their unarmed strikes. In addition, any combat maneuvers performed with these natural attacks (such as grab on a bite) can use Charisma modifier instead of Strength if it is higher.

Dinosaur Form (Sp): At 20th level, the sorcerer can transform into a dinosaur as if they used the spell beast shape IV. Unlike beast shape however the sorcerer is not limited by size, and thus can assume the full size of the dinosaur they wish to transform into. This can be used for a number of hours per day equal to her sorcerer level (these need not be consecutive, but must still be used in one-hour intervals).
